result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection in a commercial area with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the long crossing distances and lack of physical refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals.
